notice: Explicit first-MVP exclusions taken from canonical discovery. Each entry carries forbidden_terms so a validator can detect a requirement that would silently reintroduce excluded scope. A term may appear only in a requirement listed under enforced_by, which is the requirement that states the exclusion itself.
promotion_rule: An exclusion may be lifted only through an authorised scope change recorded in the canonical discovery. A derived requirements artifact must never promote excluded scope on its own authority.

exclusions.title: Online payment
exclusions.detail: Online card payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay are outside the first operational MVP. Payment occurs at the premises.

exclusions.title: Customer accounts, loyalty, and birthday benefits
exclusions.detail: Customer accounts, loyalty points, birthday rewards, and marketing campaigns are outside the first operational MVP.

exclusions.title: Delivery and table reservations
exclusions.detail: Orders are pickup-only. Delivery and table reservations are outside the first operational MVP.

exclusions.title: Coffee products
exclusions.detail: Coffee is excluded from the menu scope.

exclusions.title: Customer self-service cancellation
exclusions.detail: General customer self-service cancellation is deferred. Staff cancellation is required. The tracking page allows only the narrowly scoped alternative-slot and delay-response actions.

exclusions.title: Gram-level recipe inventory
exclusions.detail: Recipe or bill-of-material depletion and gram-level ingredient inventory are deferred. The MVP uses approximate remaining-use allowances for a small set of critical shared items.

exclusions.title: Automatic substitution and automatic reactivation
exclusions.detail: The system never substitutes an unavailable item automatically, and an estimated replenishment time never re-enables online sale automatically.

exclusions.title: Automatic recommendation engines and commercial automation
exclusions.detail: Discounts, dynamic pricing, automatic promotions, recommendation inference from sales, random recommendations, automatic cart insertion, and automatic quantity increases are excluded. Upselling is manually configured only.

exclusions.title: Compensation capabilities
exclusions.detail: Coupon codes, discount codes, automatic compensation rules, future credits, and loyalty benefits are not accepted MVP capabilities. Staff may only record the resolution actually agreed with the customer inside the incident.

exclusions.title: Half-and-half pizzas
exclusions.detail: Half-and-half pizzas are excluded initially. All pizzas have one size.

exclusions.title: Multilingual administration
exclusions.detail: Bilingual scope covers public customer content only. The administration interface is not multilingual in the first MVP.

exclusions.title: Advanced analytics and product-margin reporting
exclusions.detail: Full business analytics, conversion funnels, cohort analysis, and product-margin reporting are deferred until cost data are validated.

exclusions.title: Advanced SEO work
exclusions.detail: Advanced SEO work and SEO landing pages are outside the first operational MVP.

exclusions.title: Production hosting and public domain configuration
exclusions.detail: Production hosting, public domain configuration, and public-launch infrastructure readiness are outside the local operational implementation slice.

exclusions.title: Extensive employee and permission hierarchy
exclusions.detail: The first MVP does not need an extensive employee, permission, and escalation hierarchy. It uses principal, delegated, operational, and shared-kitchen capability boundaries only.
